* The Unicorn Horn: Utilized as a central soteriological (salvation-bringing) instrument.
* 36 Archons: Cosmic rulers spanning across 12 habitable planets.
* Jack Feist: Described as the terminal incarnation of the Logos. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHrOzAVfV-AXXhS2BSjVNc3DtliEBwAp7nsvjC1cL31cxBtEe9qdvcwME5svZ9te_WyJAI_WNhzkVsZEqzXgBmFN0mkXW2ovB1TD0SWmSWyPPMiNODV_KdQZc1t)]
